_meta.indication: ELAHERE is indicated for adult patients with FRα-positive, platinum-resistant epithelial ovarian, fallopian tube, or primary peritoneal cancer, who have received one to three prior systemic treatment regimens; select patients based on an FDA-approved test.

pivotal_trials.design: SORAYA, a single-arm international trial in which patients received mirvetuximab soravtansine-gynx 6 mg/kg intravenously every 3 weeks until disease progression or unacceptable toxicity; patients were selected by the Ventana FOLR1 (FOLR1-2.1) CDx assay.
pivotal_trials.population: Adult patients with FRα-positive, platinum-resistant epithelial ovarian, fallopian tube, or primary peritoneal cancer who had received 1-3 prior lines of therapy and all had received prior bevacizumab.
pivotal_trials.endpoint: Confirmed overall response rate (ORR) by investigator per RECIST v1.1 and duration of response (DOR).
pivotal_trials.n: 104 patients in the efficacy evaluable population (106 enrolled/treated in Study 0417).
pivotal_trials.result: Confirmed ORR by investigator per RECIST v1.1 was 31.7% (95% CI: 22.9, 41.6) and median DOR was 6.9 months (95% CI: 5.6, 9.7).

key_safety: Most common (≥20%) adverse reactions including lab abnormalities were vision impairment, fatigue, increased AST, nausea, increased ALT, keratopathy, and abdominal pain. In the pooled safety population described in Warnings and Precautions, ocular adverse reactions occurred in 61% of patients (9% Grade 3; one patient 0.2% Grade 4 keratopathy). In Study 0417 (n=106), by preferred term the Grade 3-4 rates were: vision impairment 50% all grades (Grade 3-4 7%), keratopathy 37% (9%), fatigue 49% (3%), nausea 40%, and peripheral neuropathy 33% (2%).
target_moa: A folate receptor-alpha (FRα)-directed antibody-drug conjugate: chimeric IgG1 anti-FRα, a cleavable linker, and the DM4 maytansinoid payload; DM4 disrupts the microtubule network causing cell cycle arrest and apoptotic cell death.
modality: ADC (folate receptor-alpha-directed antibody-drug conjugate with DM4 maytansinoid payload)

boxed_warning.content: WARNING: OCULAR TOXICITY — ELAHERE can cause severe ocular toxicities, including visual impairment, keratopathy, dry eye, photophobia, eye pain, and uveitis.

companion_dx_detail: Patients are selected by the Ventana FOLR1 (FOLR1-2.1) CDx (RxDx) assay, an IHC assay detecting folate receptor alpha (FOLR1) membrane staining at moderate and/or strong intensity.

advisory_committee.vote: FDA did not refer this application to an advisory committee; no efficacy or safety issues required external input.

description.text: Converted accelerated approval to full approval based on confirmatory phase 3 MIRASOL trial for platinum-resistant ovarian cancer

citations.quote: This Prior Approval supplemental biologics license application provides for the submission of the study report from the confirmatory phase 3 study IMGN853-0416 (MIRASOL), titled, *"A randomized, open-label, Phase 3 study of Mirvetuximab soravtansine vs. Investigator's choice chemotherapy in platinum-resistant, advanced, high-grade epithelial ovarian, primary peritoneal, or fallopian tube cancers with high folate receptor-alpha expression,"* to satisfy the postmarketing requirement 4347-1 of the previous accelerated approval of mirvetuximab soravtansine-gynx.

surrogate_endpoint.text: Tumor response rate (confirmed ORR 31.7%) and duration of response (median DOR 6.9 months), a surrogate reasonably likely to predict clinical benefit.

citations.quote: This indication is approved under accelerated approval based on tumor response rate and durability of response. Continued approval for this indication may be contingent upon verification and description of clinical benefit in confirmatory trials.

confirmatory_requirement.text: Complete the ongoing randomized Phase 3 confirmatory trial IMGN853-0416 (MIRASOL) comparing mirvetuximab soravtansine to investigator's choice chemotherapy, providing final PFS, ORR, and OS analyses (PMR 4347-1).

citations.quote: 4347-1 Conduct the clinical trial IMGN853-0416 (MIRASOL) titled "A randomized, open-label, Phase 3 study of Mirvetuximab soravtansine vs. Investigator's choice chemotherapy in platinum-resistant, advanced, high-grade epithelial ovarian, primary peritoneal, or fallopian tube cancers with high folate receptor-alpha expression" and provide the final progression-free survival (PFS), overall response rate (ORR), and overall survival (OS) analyses to obtain data on the clinical efficacy of mirvetuximab soravtansine for patients with platinum-resistant ovarian cancer.

summary.text: BLA 761310 received Priority review was granted accelerated approval under 21 CFR 601.41 based on confirmed ORR (31.7%) and DOR (median 6.9 months) as a surrogate reasonably likely to predict clinical benefit, with continued approval contingent on verification of clinical benefit in the confirmatory randomized Phase 3 trial IMGN853-0416 (MIRASOL).

citations.quote: It is approved under the provisions of accelerated approval regulations (21 CFR 601.41), effective on the date of this letter, for use as recommended in the enclosed agreed-upon approved labeling.

This indication is approved under accelerated approval based on tumor response rate and durability of response. Continued approval for this indication may be contingent upon verification and description of clinical benefit in confirmatory trials.
Confirmed ORR assessed by investigator according to RECIST v1.1 was 31.7% (95% CI: 22.9, 41.6) and median DOR was 6.9 months (95% CI: 5.6, 9.7).
The confirmatory, randomized trial, Study 0416 (MIRASOL, NCT04209855), was ongoing during FDA's review of the current application.

requirement.text: 4347-1 (Subpart E Accelerated Approval confirmatory): Conduct clinical trial IMGN853-0416 (MIRASOL), a randomized, open-label Phase 3 study of mirvetuximab soravtansine vs. investigator's choice chemotherapy, and provide the final PFS, ORR, and OS analyses to verify clinical benefit.

citations.quote: 4347-1 Conduct the clinical trial IMGN853-0416 (MIRASOL) titled "A randomized, open-label, Phase 3 study of Mirvetuximab soravtansine vs. Investigator's choice chemotherapy in platinum-resistant, advanced, high-grade epithelial ovarian, primary peritoneal, or fallopian tube cancers with high folate receptor-alpha expression" and provide the final progression-free survival (PFS), overall response rate (ORR), and overall survival (OS) analyses to obtain data on the clinical efficacy of mirvetuximab soravtansine for patients with platinum-resistant ovarian cancer.

requirement.text: 4347-3: Conduct an open-label, non-randomized dose escalation trial to determine an appropriate starting dose in patients with moderate hepatic impairment (NCI-ODWG), collecting safety and PK for mirvetuximab soravtansine, unconjugated DM4, and s-methyl DM4.

citations.quote: 4347-3 Conduct an open-label, non-randomized, dose escalation trial, with expansion in a sufficient number of patients, to determine an appropriate starting dose of mirvetuximab soravtansine in patients with moderate hepatic impairment, according to National Cancer Institute Organ Dysfunction Working Group (NCI-ODWG) criteria, in the target patient population.

requirement.text: 4347-4: Conduct/amend clinical trials to incorporate prospectively specified scheduled ophthalmologic assessments in all patients to further characterize the incidence and severity of ocular adverse events and evaluate risk mitigation strategies.

citations.quote: 4347-4 Conduct a clinical trial, or amend existing clinical trials, of mirvetuximab soravtansine to incorporate prospectively specified, scheduled ophthalmologic assessments in all patients (symptomatic or asymptomatic) to further characterize the incidence and severity of mirvetuximab soravtansine-related ocular adverse events and evaluate the additional risk mitigation strategies for ocular adverse events.

requirement.text: 4347-5: Conduct an integrated analysis (clinical trials, post-marketing reports, real-world evidence) to further characterize the safety and efficacy of mirvetuximab soravtansine in patients from racial and ethnic minority groups vs White patients.

citations.quote: 4347-5 Conduct an integrated analysis containing data from clinical trials and other data sources such as post-marketing reports, real-world evidence and other sources to further characterize the safety and efficacy of mirvetuximab soravtansine in patients from racial and ethnic minority groups.
